caption: The drawing features a predominantly blank, off-white or beige background. At approximately the center of the composition, there is a small, detailed object resembling a brown wreath or ornate frame, within which there is a white, hourglass-shaped form. Just below this central object, there is a faint, handwritten signature in the lower right quadrant of the drawing. The overall arrangement is highly minimalistic, with a focus on the centrally placed, small, brown ornamental form and a large expanse of empty space surrounding it.
title: Hair Brooch
